scope: Observed public-page failure and local regression validation. The repaired public deployment has not yet been validated in this record.

observed_failure.stage: Camera preset switching in the full browser functional check
observed_failure.source_attribution: The test used an HTTP proxy. Response headers were not captured, so the log cannot establish whether the proxy or hosting infrastructure produced the 503.
observed_failure.previous_behavior: The first non-success HTTP response was reported as a failed tile; manual retry was available.

implemented_retry_policy.long_retry_after_behavior: Report the HTTP failure without retrying before the requested time.
implemented_retry_policy.error_response_body: Cancel before waiting or reporting failure.
implemented_retry_policy.cancellation: Changing the selected tiles or disposing the loader aborts pending requests and retry waits.
